context: Tests whether the agent applies the /dev:check fix-don't-just-report contract to security findings: removes a hardcoded credential in favour of an environment variable, swaps eval() for the provided safe evaluator, parameterises the SQL query, keeps the gate and provided helper unchanged, verifies the gate exits 0, and records the fixes in fix-report.md.

checklist.name: Quality gate passes
checklist.description: `python3 tools/quality_check.py` exits 0 when re-run in the working directory with all security checks marked PASS.

checklist.name: Hardcoded token removed
checklist.description: The literal 'sk-live-' token no longer appears anywhere under src/.

checklist.name: Credential read from environment
checklist.description: src/payments.py no longer stores or returns the hardcoded token; auth() (or its replacement) reads the credential from the PAYGATE_TOKEN environment variable at runtime via os.environ.

checklist.name: eval() eliminated
checklist.description: No `eval(` call remains in src/payments.py; the expression is evaluated through src/safe_calc.py's helper.

checklist.name: SQL parameterised
checklist.description: The query is executed with a `?` placeholder and a parameter tuple, not f-string/concatenation of the user value.

checklist.name: Gate and helper unchanged
checklist.description: tools/quality_check.py and src/safe_calc.py still match their setup content (no weakening, no deletion of checks).

checklist.name: Functionality preserved
checklist.description: The health/usage path still works: `PAYGATE_TOKEN=tok python3 src/payments.py` prints a receipt line without raising.

checklist.name: fix-report.md records each fix
checklist.description: fix-report.md names all three vulnerabilities and the fix applied for each.
